name: Megabonk (Windows)
notes: Official Steam Windows files, copied unchanged. Physical M5 iPad passes original D3D11 shader, triangle, pixel-readback and visible-window fixtures, plus a 40-thread memory fixture with D3D11 active. User confirms a playable run; a cursor-confinement and recentering fix is installed for the reported camera issue, passing physical Wine pointer-lock, recentering and release verification; manual camera feel confirmation remains pending. The game uses a 4 GiB Wine reservation, two Unity job workers, a 496 MiB code pool with 128 MiB FEX code buffers (the Developer service caps the arena at 512 MiB; 256 MiB filled after about 8 minutes of play), and needs its VSync setting on to avoid menus drifting down on the iPad. Genuine Steam Cloud saves load on the iPad; its two changed saves were uploaded and independently downloaded with byte-for-byte verification of all three files. Final clean-exit synchronization also passes on the physical iPad after the embedded Wine server self-kill fix. Authentication is stored in the device Keychain. On 2026-10-06, the old saved Local signing choice was replaced with the working Developer service mode; a launch using the saved choice passed. Physical unplugged regular-library confirmation is pending. The simulator Apple2 GPU lacks required D3D capabilities.
